name: frontier-infra
description: Design and build governed agent systems with Frontier Infra patterns, installable SDK components, and evidence-bound verification.

interface.longDescription: Design and implement governed agent systems without tying the architecture to one model, coding harness, or dashboard. Frontier Infra provides the patterns, contracts, SDK adoption workflow, deterministic control boundaries, independent verification, runtime health, evidence receipts, and conformance discipline needed to turn an agent loop into operable infrastructure.
defaultPrompt: Design a reliable AI harness for my workflow.
Add Frontier SDK governance plumbing to my agent application.
Audit my agent system against The Machine.
